user.title: Connect KitchenOwl
user.description: EatFresh saves recipes in KitchenOwl and puts ingredients on your shopping list. Enter the address of your KitchenOwl server and a long-lived access token (KitchenOwl: Settings > Sessions > Long-lived tokens).

data_description.url: Address of your KitchenOwl server, for example {example_url}
data_description.token: The token is stored in Home Assistant and never shown again.

household.title: Choose household
household.description: Recipes are saved in this KitchenOwl household.

shoppinglist.title: Choose shopping list
shoppinglist.description: Ingredients go onto this shopping list.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew KitchenOwl access
reauth_confirm.description: KitchenOwl rejected the access token. Enter a new long-lived access token.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
error.cannot_connect: KitchenOwl cannot be reached at this address.
error.no_households: This account has no household in KitchenOwl.
error.no_shoppinglists: This household has no shopping list in KitchenOwl.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the log for details.

abort.already_configured: EatFresh is already set up for this household.
abort.single_instance_allowed: EatFresh is already set up. Only one setup is possible.

init.title: Recipe sources and meal plan
init.description:
Choose the websites EatFresh searches. Pasting a recipe link always works. EatFresh only loads a page when you search or open a recipe.

Chefkoch is off by default. Its terms of use (section 5.1) restrict automated access. If you turn Chefkoch on, you use it at your own risk and responsibility.

EatFresh fetches the KitchenOwl meal plan at the interval below and after every change made in EatFresh.

data.accept_chefkoch_terms: I have read the Chefkoch terms (section 5.1) and use Chefkoch at my own responsibility

data_description.accept_chefkoch_terms: Required only if Chefkoch is selected.
data_description.planner_interval: How often EatFresh fetches the meal plan for the calendar, the sensor and the cards (1 to 60 minutes). Each fetch is one request to KitchenOwl.

error.chefkoch_terms: To use Chefkoch, confirm that you have read its terms and use it at your own responsibility.

import_recipe.name: Import recipe
import_recipe.description: Loads a recipe from a web address and saves it in KitchenOwl. An existing recipe with the same address is reused.

url.name: Address
url.description: Web address of the recipe page.

add_recipe_to_shopping_list.name: Add recipe to shopping list
add_recipe_to_shopping_list.description: Puts the ingredients of a KitchenOwl recipe on the configured shopping list.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: ID of the recipe in KitchenOwl.

search_collection.name: Search collection
search_collection.description: Returns the recipes saved in KitchenOwl whose name or an ingredient contains the search text, with the days they are planned on. Hidden recipes are left out.

query.name: Search text
query.description: Part of the name or of an ingredient, any case. Leave empty for the whole collection.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Most recipes in the response (1 to 200, default 50). The response names the number of all matches in total.

name_only.name: Name only
name_only.description: Compare the search text only with the recipe name, not with the ingredients. Default: off.

get_planner.name: Get meal plan
get_planner.description: Returns the meals planned in KitchenOwl from a start day on a number of days, and the recipes planned without a day.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days from the start day (1 to 31). Default: 7.

plan_recipe.name: Plan recipe
plan_recipe.description: Plans a recipe of the collection on a day in the KitchenOwl meal plan.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: ID of the recipe in KitchenOwl.

date.name: Day
date.description: Day the recipe is planned on.

unplan_recipe.name: Remove recipe from plan
unplan_recipe.description: Takes a recipe off a day of the KitchenOwl meal plan. The recipe itself stays.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: ID of the recipe in KitchenOwl.

date.name: Day
date.description: Day to remove the recipe from. Leave empty to remove the entry without a day.
